rule: **Rust**: no module prefix: `Type#method` (impl and trait methods), free functions bare | **high**: the callee is a function/method/constructor defined in the scanned source (the tool matched it to a definition).
source: KNOWN_GAP: extension-trait methods on external types are named as the external type at medium
notes: Layout: src/ (the scan root) holds a Cargo package, Cargo.toml plus src/*.rs, so module paths are crate-relative. The scanned extension trait Shout is implemented for the external types String and str; impl methods are Type#method, so the scan defines String#shout and str#shout. s: String and r: &str (&T → pointee) resolve to those definitions → high, not medium (C5: confidence reports the evidence, and the tool has the definition). String::new / String::from are std associated functions → medium. call_type: SPEC lists direct|method without defining them; this corpus uses method for every callee of the form Type#m / recv.m / .m (including path calls Type::assoc()) and direct for free functions, module-path functions and named nested functions.
